item.title: Korea-U.S. Summit Phone Call – Trump: “Will Play Necessary Role for Peace on the Korean Peninsula” (한·미 정상 통화…트럼프 “한반도 평화 위해 필요한 역할 할 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung held a phone call with President Donald Trump on the 17th, exchanging views on the outcomes of the U.S.-China summit and ways to develop Korea-U.S. relations. (이재명 대통령이 17일 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 전화통화를 하고 미-중 정상회담 결과와 한미 관계 발전 방안 등에 대해 의견을 교환했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jeong announced that the two leaders spoke by phone for 30 minutes starting at 10 PM. This call was arranged at the request of the Korean government to share the results of the U.S.-China summit. It marks the first direct conversation between the two leaders in 200 days since their previous summit held in Gyeongju on October 29 of last year. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 한미 정상이 밤 10시부터 30분간 전화 통화를 했다고 밝혔다. 이번 통화는 한국 정부가 미-중 정상회담 결과 공유를 요청해 이뤄졌다. 지난해 10월29일 경주에서 열린 한-미 정상회담 이후 양국 정상이 직접 통화한 것은 200일 만이다.)

President Lee conveyed congratulations on President Trump’s successful state visit to China, the first in nine years, and assessed that the stable management of U.S.-China relations would contribute to peace and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region and the world. Senior Spokesperson Kang reported that President Trump explained the overall outcomes of the summit, including U.S.-China relations, economic and trade agreements, and the situations on the Korean Peninsula and the Middle East. Earlier, President Trump made his first state visit to China in nine years, completing summit schedules with President Xi Jinping from the 14th to the 15th (local time). (이 대통령은 9년 만에 이뤄진 트럼프 대통령의 국빈 방중이 성공적으로 이뤄진 것에 축하 인사를 전달하고, 미중 관계의 안정적 관리가 인도·태평양 지역과 전 세계의 평화와 번영에 기여할 것이라고 평가했다. 트럼프 대통령은 미중 관계 전반과 경제·무역 합의, 한반도 및 중동 정세 등 정상회담 결과를 설명했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. 앞서 트럼프 대통령은 9년 만에 방중해 14일(현지시각)부터 이틀간 시진핑 국가주석과 정상회담 일정 등을 소화했다.)

The two leaders also discussed issues concerning peace on the Korean Peninsula. President Lee praised the constructive discussions on Korean Peninsula issues between President Trump and President Xi Jinping. In response, President Trump stated that he would continue to play the necessary role and make contributions for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, based on close cooperation between the leaders of Korea and the U.S. (또 양 정상은 한반도 평화 문제에 대해서도 논의를 나눴다. 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령과 시진핑 주석이 한반도 문제에 대해 건설적인 협의를 가진 것을 평가했고, 트럼프 대통령은 앞으로도 한미 정상 간의 긴밀한 공조를 기초로 한반도의 평화와 안정을 위해 필요한 역할과 기여를 해나가겠다고 화답했다.)

Additionally, regarding key pending issues between Korea and the U.S., the two leaders discussed the smooth implementation of the Joint Fact Sheet (JFS) signed by the two leaders in November of last year. Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, “The two leaders recalled that the Joint Fact Sheet, announced last year, is a historic agreement that upgraded the Korea-U.S. alliance to a new level, and agreed to make efforts for the faithful implementation of the agreement.” (아울러 한미 간 주요 현안과 관련해, 지난해 11월 한미 정상이 체결한 공동설명자료(JFS·조인트 팩트시트)의 원활한 이행에 대해서도 얘기를 주고받았다. 강 수석대변인은 “양 정상은 지난해 발표한 공동설명자료가 한미동맹을 새로운 차원으로 업그레이드한 역사적 합의라는 점을 상기하고, 합의의 충실한 이행을 위해 노력해 나가자고 했다”고 말했다.)

In relation to economic and security cooperation issues between the two countries, it is likely that discussions covered follow-up consultations on tariff matters, such as the “No. 1 U.S. Investment,” the Korea-U.S. nuclear agreement, and the construction of nuclear-powered submarines. Earlier that day, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac appeared on Korean Broadcasting System (KBS) and stated, “Security-related negotiation issues are interconnected with economic issues and are being influenced accordingly, but there have been many behind-the-scenes consultations, and progress is being made.” (양국 간 경제·안보 협력 현안과 관련해서는, ‘대미투자 1호’ 등 관세 분야 후속 협의와 한미 원자력 협정, 핵추진 잠수함 건설 등에 대한 얘기가 오갔을 것으로 보인다. 앞서 이날 위성락 국가안보실장은 한국방송(KBS)에 출연해 “안보 관련 협상 이슈들이 경제 쪽 이슈들과 연동돼 영향을 받고 있다고 했는데, 그 부분도 막후에서 많은 협의를 하고 있고, 협의에 진전이 있다”고 말한 바 있다.)

President Lee also commended President Trump’s active leadership in resolving the Middle East situation and expressed hope for a swift restoration of peace and stability in the region. Senior Spokesperson Kang added, “The two leaders expressed anticipation for their reunion at the upcoming Group of Seven (G7) summit scheduled for mid-next month.” (또 이 대통령은 중동 상황 해결을 위한 트럼프 대통령의 적극적 리더십을 평가하고, 중동에서 평화와 안정이 조속히 회복되기를 희망한다고 말했다. 강 수석대변인은 “양 정상은 다음 달 중순 예정된 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에서의 재회에 대한 기대감을 표명했다”고 밝혔다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: June 3 Local Elections Candidate Registration Closes…At Least 504 Expected to Be Elected Unopposed (6·3 지방선거 후보등록 마감…504명 무투표 당선 예상)
item.description:
The National Election Commission announced on the 17th that at least 504 candidates, about 12% of the total elected positions (4,227), are expected to be elected unopposed in the June 3 local elections, with no competition. (6·3 지방선거에서 경쟁 없이 당선이 확정되는 무투표 당선자가 전체 당선정수(당선인 수·4227명)의 약 12%인 최소 504명이라고 중앙선거관리위원회가 17일 집계했다.)

According to a press release from the National Election Commission, following the close of local election candidate registration on the 15th, 504 candidates (3 basic local government heads, 108 regional metropolitan councilors, 305 regional basic councilors, and 88 proportional representation basic councilors) from 307 electoral districts are expected to be elected unopposed. Due to variables such as candidate withdrawals or registration invalidations, the final unopposed winners will be confirmed on election day. The basic local government head candidates effectively decided to be elected unopposed are Kim Yi-gang, head of Gwangju Seo-gu Office; Kim Byeong-nae, head of Gwangju Nam-gu Office; and Im Byeong-taek, candidate for mayor of Siheung, Gyeonggi Province, all belonging to the Democratic Party of Korea. Of the 108 unopposed metropolitan councilors, 84 (77.8%) came from the Yeongnam and Honam regions, where party affiliations are clear. ( 지난 15일 지방선거 후보 등록 마감 결과, 선거구 307곳에서 504명(기초단체장 3명, 지역구 광역의원 108명, 지역구 기초의원 305명, 비례대표 기초의원 88명)의 무투표 당선자가 나올 것으로 예상된다고 중앙선관위가 보도자료를 내어 밝혔다. 후보자 사퇴나 등록 무효 등의 변수로, 최종 무투표 당선자는 선거일에 확정된다. 무투표 당선이 사실상 결정된 기초단체장 후보는 김이강 광주 서구청장, 김병내 광주 남구청장, 임병택 경기 시흥시장 후보 3명으로 모두 더불어민주당 소속이다. 광역의원 무투표 당선자는 전체 108명 중 84명(77.8%)이 지지 정당이 뚜렷한 영호남 지역에서 나왔다.)

The number of candidates registered for this local election is 7,782, with an average competition ratio of 1.8 to 1, matching the level of the 2022 local elections, the lowest ever. Female candidates numbered 2,453 (31.5%), surpassing 30% for the first time in local elections history. The average age of all candidates was 54.7 years, with an age difference of 67 years between the oldest candidate (85 years) and the youngest candidate (18 years). There were 1,507 young candidates (19.4%) aged 45 or under, and 7 teenage candidates registered. ( 이번 지방선거에 등록한 후보 수는 7782명으로, 평균 경쟁률은 1.8 대 1을 기록해 역대 최저치였던 2022년 지방선거와 같은 수준을 보였다. 여성 후보는 2453명(31.5%)으로 역대 지방선거 최초로 여성 출마자 비율이 30%를 넘어섰다. 후보자 전체 평균 나이는 54.7살로, 최고령 후보자(85살)와 최연소 후보자(18살)의 나이 차이는 67살이었다. 만 45살 이하 청년 후보는 모두 1507명(19.4%)이었고, 10대 후보자는 7명이 등록했다.)

The average property value of local election candidates is approximately 903.13 million won. The average property value of metropolitan government head candidates was about 1.89451 billion won, more than double the average, with Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, reporting the highest property at 7.28961 billion won. ( 지방선거 후보자들의 평균 재산액은 약 9억313만원이다. 광역단체장 후보들의 평균 재산액은 약 18억9451만원으로 평균의 두배가 넘었고, 그중 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 72억8961만원으로 가장 많은 재산을 신고했다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: While North Korea's Women's Football Team Visits South... Kim Jong-un Orders "Frontline Units Strengthened" (북 여자축구단 한국 온 사이…김정은 “최전방 부대 강화” 지시)
item.description:
Amid the visit of North Korea's women's football team, "Naegohyang Women's Football Team," to the South, Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of North Korea, convened all-unit commanders and ordered the reinforcement of units along the Military Demarcation Line separating the two Koreas. (북한 여자 축구팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 방남한 가운데, 김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 북한 국무위원장이 전군 지휘관을 소집하고, 남북이 접하는 군사분계선 일대 부대를 강화할 것을 지시했다.)

The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 18th that Chairman Kim Jong-un had summoned commanders of divisions and brigades from all military units the previous day (the 17th). The meeting included Ri Yong-gil, Chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, and Park Jong-chon, an advisor to the Ministry of National Defense. The agency stated that Chairman Kim encouraged the commanders and delivered remarks on "important military issues." (조선중앙통신은 김정은 위원장이 전날(17일) 전군의 사단·여단 지휘관들을 소집했다고 18일 보도했다. 여기엔 리영길 조선인민군 총참모장과 박정천 국방성 고문도 참가했다. 통신은 김 위원장이 지휘관들을 격려하며, ‘중요 군사문제들’에 대해 담화했다고 전했다.)

The agency reported that Kim specifically addressed the party's territorial defense policy regarding strengthening the first-line units guarding the southern border and turning the borderline into an impregnable fortress. The southern border refers to the area around the Military Demarcation Line between the two Koreas. At the meeting, Kim "expressed his plan for reorganizing the military structure and militarily and technologically strengthening key units, including the first-line units, as an important decision to more thoroughly deter war," the agency reported. (김 위원장은 특히 남부 국경을 지키고 있는 제1선 부대들을 강화하고, 국경선을 난공불락의 요새로 만드는 데 대한 당의 영토방위정책을 언급했다고 통신은 보도했다. 남부 국경은 남북 군사분계선 일대를 의미한다. 김 위원장은 이 자리에서 “전쟁을 보다 철저히 억제하기 위한 중요한 결정으로서 앞으로 취하게 될 군사조직 구조 개편과 제1선부대를 비롯한 중요부대들을 군사기술적으로 강화하기 위한 구상을 피력했다”고 통신은 전했다.)

However, the specific details of the "important decision" mentioned by Chairman Kim were not included in the report. Regarding the strengthening of the southern border, the agency had previously reported on the 6th that Kim, during a visit to a "key munitions factory," stated plans to deploy new 155mm self-propelled artillery systems capable of targeting Seoul. (다만 김 위원장이 말하는 ‘중요한 결정’의 구체적인 내용은 보도에 담기지 않았다. 김 위원장은 남부 국경 강화와 관련해, 통신은 지난 6일 ‘중요군수기업소’를 방문했을 때 서울을 사정권에 두는 신형 155㎜ 자주포를 배치할 것이라고 전한 바 있다.)

At the meeting, Chairman Kim stated, "We will establish organizational measures to renew the military in terms of organizational structure and military technology," and emphasized the role of commanders in implementing these measures. He said, "We must actively accelerate planning efforts to redefine operational concepts in all spaces and apply them to combat training, in line with the rapid modernization of the military's technical equipment." (김 위원장은 이날 회의에서 “군대를 군사 편제, 군사 기술적으로 갱신하기 위한 기구적 대책을 세울 것”이라며 이를 집행하기 위한 지휘관들의 역할도 강조했다. 그는 “군의 군사 기술 장비들이 급속한 속도로 현대화되는 데 맞게 모든 공간에서의 작전개념을 새롭게 정의하고 부대들의 전투훈련에 적용하기 위한 계획 사업들도 적극 다그쳐야 한다”고 말했다.)

Chairman Kim then discussed the prospects of military modernization and the development of military technical equipment, stressing, "Once the five-year plan tasks are completed, the military's readiness will be renewed beyond comparison with the present, bringing about significant changes in terms of war deterrence." (김 위원장은 이어 군의 현대화 전망과 군사기술 장비들의 발전 상황을 전하며 “5개년 계획 과제를 수행하면 군의 준비태세는 현재와 비교할 수 없도록 갱신되고, 전쟁 억제의 측면에서 큰 변화를 맞이할 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Meanwhile, on this day, neither KCNA nor the Workers' Party newspaper *Rodong Sinmun*, which is read by North Korean residents, reported on the Naegohyang Women's Football Team, which arrived in Suwon on the 17th to participate in the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League semifinals. (한편 이날 조선중앙통신이나 북한 주민들이 보는 노동신문은 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자챔피언스 리그 4강전 출전을 위해 17일 수원에 도착한 내고향여자축구단에 대한 보도는 하지 않았다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking News] Ahead of Samsung Electronics Negotiations, President Lee Says, "Corporate Management Rights Must Also Be Respected" ([속보] 삼성전자 협상 직전, 이 대통령 “기업경영권도 존중돼야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 18th, "In the Republic of Korea, which has adopted a free democratic basic order and a capitalist market economy system, labor must be respected as much as corporations, and corporate management rights must be respected as much as labor rights." This is interpreted as a remark directed at Samsung Electronics' labor and management, who have announced a general strike for the 21st. (이재명 대통령이 18일 “자유민주적 기본질서와 자본주의적 시장경제질서를 채택한 대한민국에서는 기업만큼 노동도 존중되어야 하고, 노동권만큼 기업경영권도 존중돼야 한다”고 밝혔다. 오는 21일 총파업을 예고한 삼성전자 노사를 향한 발언으로 해석된다.)

President Lee said on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "Workers must be able to receive fair compensation for the labor they provide, and shareholders who take on risks and losses through investment are entitled to a share of corporate profits," adding, "At one time, the founding constitution stipulated workers' right to equal participation in corporate profits." This appears to be pressure on Samsung Electronics' labor and management to seek a compromise ahead of the second post-mediation meeting between Samsung Electronics labor and management, which began at 10 a.m. that day. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “노동자는 노무 제공에 대해 정당한 노동의 대가를 받을 수 있어야 하고, 위험과 손실을 부담하며 투자한 주주들은 기업이윤에 몫을 가진다”며 “한때 제헌 헌법에 노동자의 기업이익 균점권이 규정된 적도 있었다”고 말했다. 이날 오전 10시부터 열리는 삼성전자 노사의 2차 사후조정 회의를 앞두고, 삼성전자 노사를 향해 타협에 나서라고 압박한 것으로 보인다.)

Furthermore, President Lee stated, "Under the current constitution, the basic rights of all citizens are guaranteed, but they may be limited for public welfare, etc., within the scope that does not infringe on their essential content," adding, "Just as there are shady areas as well as sunny ones, and as mountains are high, valleys are deep. Going too far is as bad as falling short, and things will turn in the opposite direction when they reach extremes." (아울러 이 대통령은 “현행 헌법상 모든 국민의 기본권은 보장되지만, 본질적 내용을 침해하지 않는 범위내에서 공공복리 등을 위해 제한될 수 있다”며 “양지만큼 음지가 있고 산이 높으면 골짜기도 깊은 법이다. 과유불급 물극필반”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee also said, "It's not about having more because you are stronger or being happier; rather, a world where we stand in solidarity, take responsibility, and all prosper together is the future of the new Republic of Korea." (이 대통령은 또 “힘 세다고 더 많이 가지고 더 행복한 것이 아니라, 연대하고 책임지며 모두가 함께 잘 사는 세상이 새로운 대한민국의 미래”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Park Yong-jin: "Samsung Electronics Risks Falling from National Pride to a Source of Concern" (박용진 “삼성전자, 자칫 국민 자부심에서 근심거리 전락할 수 있어”)
item.description:
Park Yong-jin, deputy head of the Regulatory Reform Committee who has been active as a "Samsung sniper," said on the 18th regarding the Samsung Electronics strike controversy that "Samsung Electronics could potentially fall from being a national pride to a national concern. The union could truly become disliked by the public." (‘삼성 저격수’로 활약했던 박용진 규제합리회위원회 부위원장이 18일 삼성전자 파업 논란과 관련해 “자칫 삼성전자가 국민 자부심에서 국민 근심거리로 전락할 수 있다. 노조는 진짜 국민 밉상이 될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on CBS Radio's "Park Seong-tae's News Show" that day, Deputy Head Park stated, "From decades of experience in labor-management negotiations and labor movements, even a small union gains an upper hand in negotiations if it receives public support and applause; otherwise, even if it follows all legal procedures for a strike, it is bound to lose." He added, "If you insist on going ahead unconditionally because it's a right, you won't escape isolation." (박 부위원장은 이날 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에 출연해 “아무리 작은 노조도 국민의 응원과 박수를 받으면 협상의 우위에 서고, 그렇지 않으면 파업의 법적 절차를 다 지켰다 하더라도 패할 수밖에 없다는 게 지난 수십년 노사 협상과 노동운동의 경험”이라며 “(노동자의) 권리니까 무조건 고(go)하겠다고 하면 고립무원의 처지를 벗어날 수 없을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's statement the previous day about considering invoking the emergency adjustment power due to massive damage to the national economy, he described it as "a pressure tactic to force negotiations." He pointed out, "In 2024, when Samsung Electronics posted a deficit, its corporate tax was zero, yet it continued to receive R&D tax credits, and the Semiconductor Chip Act was enacted with enormous taxpayer money. The union must present arguments and plans that consider public opinion to build a sustainable company." (그는 전날 김민석 국무총리가 국민경제의 막대한 피해를 이유로 긴급조정권 발동을 검토하겠다고 밝힌 것에 대해 “협상을 강제하기 위한 압박용”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “2024년 삼성전자가 적자가 났을 때 법인세 ‘제로’였음에도 연구개발(R&D) 세액공제도 계속해 주고, 반도체칩스법도 만들어주는 등 엄청난 혈세가 들어갔다”며 “국민적 시선을 고려해 지속가능한 기업을 만들기 위한 노조의 주장과 계획이 있어야 한다”고 지적했다.)

Deputy Head Park criticized, "Hyundai Motor's labor and management have faced severe conflicts, but through that, they know each other well, have negotiation skills, and understand the importance of fostering a cooperative ecosystem and supply chain. In contrast, Samsung, which previously championed union-free management, is now acting recklessly with words and actions without establishing mutual rules." (박 부위원장은 “현대자동차 노사가 엄청난 갈등을 겪어왔는데, 그러다보니 서로를 잘 알고 협상의 기술이 있고, 협력업체와 생태계를 잘 조성하는 게 중요하다는 걸 알고 있다”며 “무노조 경영을 앞세웠던 삼성에서 오히려 서로 룰을 만들지 못한 채 입으로, 현상으로 과격하게 나가고 있다”고 꼬집었다.)

Park Ji-won, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, also appeared on SBS's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show" that day and said, "The best thing Prime Minister Kim Min-seok has done recently is his statement about considering invoking the emergency adjustment power." He added, "All politics and social movements must move forward with the people. Abandoning public sentiment means you cannot move forward and cannot win." He further noted, "Samsung must also show consideration for its workers, but workers must also move forward with the public and public sentiment." (박지원 더불어민주당 의원도 이날 에스비에스(SBS) ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에 출연해 “김민석 총리가 최근 제일 잘한 일이 긴급조정권을 발동(검토)하겠다 한 것”이라며 “모든 정치나 사회운동은 국민과 함께 가야한다. 민심을 버리면 함께 할 수 없고, 승리할 수 없다”고 말했다. 그는 “삼성도 노동자에 대한 배려를 해야 하지만, 노동자들도 국민과 민심과 함께 가야 된다는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk's 'Gwangju Visit'… "Does he want to get hit by an egg and play the victim?" (장동혁 ‘5·18 광주행’…“계란 맞아 피해자 행세하려고?”)
item.description:
As Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, plans to visit Gwangju on the 18th to attend the 46th anniversary ceremony of the May 18 Democratization Movement, Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for Ulsan mayor, criticized, saying, "Jang, who has not properly reflected on the December 3 insurrection, has no right to pay respects at the May 18 Democracy Cemetery." From the ruling party, a suggestion emerged that "visiting Gwangju is to get hit by an egg and play the victim," proposing, "let's just ignore him." <<> Candidate Kim said on KBS Radio's "Jeon Gyeok Si Sa" that day, "Since the December 3 insurrection, Jang has not offered proper reflection. Does someone like that have the right to face the May 18 martyrs?" <<> Kim added, "May 18 was a citizens' uprising against Chun Doo-hwan's martial law, and this just uprising was brutally trampled under military boots and slashed with swords and guns," pointing out, "A similar event was attempted on the night of December 3, 2024, and can the May 18 martyrs accept someone who comes only in body, without proper reflection, sincere apology, or action—just empty words?" He emphasized, "Jang has no right to visit the May 18 Democracy Cemetery." <<> There were also claims that "ignoring him is the answer" regarding Jang's Gwangju visit. Min Hyung-bae, the Democratic Party's candidate for the integrated mayor of the Jeonnam-Gwangju special city, alleged on Facebook that day, "I do not believe his visit is a step of sincere apology and repentance. Rather, it seems like a calculated schedule to get hit by an 'egg' from angry citizens and play the victim." <<> Min urged, "Let's not get caught up in Jang's shallow calculations. Don't create the scenes he wants. Instead of engaging and boosting his stature, let's just ignore him. Let's frustrate Jang Dong-hyuk's dirty intentions with a calm 'silence'." Last November 6, after becoming party leader, Jang visited the Gwangju National May 18 Democracy Cemetery for the first time but was blocked by civic groups and had to turn away without paying respects. <<> Criticism also continued over the People Power Party's refusal to participate in the vote on a constitutional amendment to include the spirit of May 18 in the preamble. Park Hyun-ok, senior vice president of the May 18 Democratic Martyrs' Families Association, pointed out on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus," "I want to ask whether People Power Party lawmakers truly have the right to visit the cemetery." <<> Vice President Park said, "If Jang truly intended to include the May 18 spirit in the constitutional preamble, he could never have made non-participation in the vote a party policy. No matter how much we think about it and try to understand, it is incomprehensible." She added, "It feels like the People Power Party, led by Jang, is not just mocking the bereaved families, May families, or patriots, but ridiculing and belittling all citizens." <<> Earlier, on the 7th, a constitutional amendment bill presented to the National Assembly plenary session was declared "invalid due to lack of quorum" as the People Power Party, under party policy, refused to participate in the vote. This amendment included incorporating the spirits of the Busan-Masan Democratic Protests and the May 18 Democratization Movement into the constitutional preamble, introducing parliamentary approval for the president's declaration of martial law, and upgrading the National Assembly's request for martial law lift to a lifting right. The People Power Party stated, "It's not that we oppose constitutional amendment itself," citing the reason of "guarding against a 'patchwork amendment' that hastily handles only some content to fit the election schedule" (Chief Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin). <<> Jeon Gwang-jun Reporter light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 18일 광주를 찾아 5·18민주화운동 46주년 기념식에 참석할 예정인 가운데, 김상욱 더불어민주당 울산시장 후보가 “12·3 내란에 대해 제대로 된 반성 없는 장 대표는 5·18민주묘지를 참배할 자격이 없다”고 비판했다. 여권에서는 “계란이라도 맞아 피해자 행세”를 하기 위한 광주 방문이라며 “무시하자”는 제안도 나왔다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Women's Committee: "Primaries Only Fair? Irresponsible Candidate Selection for Gender Equality" (민주당 여성위 “경선만이 공정? 성평등 무책임 공천”)
item.description:
The National Women's Committee of the Democratic Party of Korea criticized that the candidate nominations for the June 3 local elections "once again confirmed the deep-rooted gender imbalance and the solid glass ceiling." (더불어민주당 전국여성위원회가 6·3 지방선거 후보 공천이 “여전히 뿌리 깊은 성별 불균형과 견고한 유리천장을 다시 한번 확인시켜 주었다”고 비판했다.)

According to a statement issued by the National Women's Committee on the 18th, female candidates for basic local government heads accounted for only 18 out of 221, or 8.14%. The committee stated, "Compared to 13 female candidates in the local elections four years ago, this is an increase of 5, but the female ratio has not even surpassed the 10% barrier. In particular, female nominations were very sluggish in the Seoul metropolitan area, with 1 in Seoul, 3 in Gyeonggi, and 1 in Incheon." Among the 16 candidates for metropolitan government heads, only one, Choo Mi-ae, the Gyeonggi governor candidate, is a woman. (18일 전국여성위가 낸 성명을 보면, 기초단체장 여성 후보는 221명 중 18명으로 8.14%에 불과했다. 여성위는 “4년 전 지방선거 13명에 비해 5명 늘어났지만 여성 비율이 10%의 벽도 넘기지 못했고, 특히 서울 1명, 경기 3명, 인천 1명 등 수도권 지역에서 여성 공천은 매우 부진했다”고 밝혔다. 광역단체장 후보도 16명 가운데 여성 후보는 추미애 경기지사 후보 1명이다.)

The committee particularly criticized the party leadership, stating, "Basic local government heads are the core of local administration, but they are heavily skewed toward men. The long-accumulated gender imbalance in the political sphere creates structural inequality for women. Active measures by political parties, such as strategic nominations to address the gender imbalance, are essential. However, in this nomination process, the leadership left the skewed playing field as it was, only talking about 'primaries' as 'fairness' and invoking individual competitiveness—this is nothing but irresponsibility that shirks the duty of gender equality." (여성위는 특히 “기초단체장은 지방행정의 핵심인데, 남성에게 매우 편중되어 있다. 오랫동안 축적되어 온 정치영역의 성별 불균형은 여성에 대한 구조적 불평등을 낳는다”며 “성별 불균형을 해소하기 위한 전략공천 등 정당의 적극적 조치가 필수적인데, 이번 공천 과정에서 기울어진 운동장은 그냥 놔둔 채 ‘경선’만이 ‘공정’이라며 개인 경쟁력을 운운한 것은 성평등 책무로부터 도망치는 무책임일 뿐”이라고 당 지도부를 비판했다.)

Even in the Democratic Party's nominations for metropolitan council district seats, the female ratio stood at only 26.12%. For basic council district seats, it was 33.26%. Including proportional representation candidates, female candidates for metropolitan councils exceeded 30%, and for basic councils, they reached 41.8%. The committee noted, "This is progress achieved through tearful challenges and fierce competition by numerous female candidates," but added, "These results are due to the system of a '50% quota for proportional representation seats.'" The committee stated, "The female nomination rate for metropolitan council districts, which did not surpass the 30% threshold, is a must-solve task for the next election." (민주당 광역의원 지역구 공천에서도 여성 비율은 26.12%에 그쳤다. 기초의원 지역구는 33.26%다. 비례대표 후보를 포함하면 광역의원 후보는 30%를 넘었고, 기초의원 후보는 41.8%로 나타났다. 여성위는 “수많은 여성 후보들의 눈물겨운 도전과 치열한 경쟁 끝에 이뤄낸 진전”이라면서도 “이런 성과는 비례대표 50% 할당제’라는 제도가 있었기 때문”이라고 했다. 여성위는 “30% 문턱을 넘지 못한 광역의원 지역구 여성 공천은 다음 선거에서 반드시 해결해야 할 필수 과제”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon declares “With a badge, I’ll smash the Democratic Party”… Park Ji-won says “It’s obvious he’ll lose” (한동훈 “배지 달고 민주당 박살” 공언에…박지원 “낙선 뻔한데”)
item.description:

item.title: President Lee: "Will Do Our Best to Enshrine the May 18 Spirit in the Preamble of the Constitution" (이 대통령 “5·18 정신 헌법 전문에 수록하도록 최선 다할 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 18th, "I will do my utmost to ensure that the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement is included in the preamble of the Constitution." (이재명 대통령이 18일 “5·18 정신이 반드시 헌법 전문에 수록될 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks while attending the "46th Anniversary Commemoration Ceremony of the May 18 Democratization Movement" held that morning at the May 18 Democracy Square in front of the former Jeonnam Provincial Government Office in Gwangju. He said, "In 1980, the 'Great Unity World' that Gwangju mustered all its strength to bloom in that fleeting space where unjust power withdrew, was reborn in 2024 as the 'Revolution of Light' that protected democracy with each other's body heat on that harsh winter night." President Lee then added, "On this occasion, I bow my head before the noble souls of the May democratic martyrs who willingly sacrificed themselves for democracy, expressing infinite respect and deep condolences." (이 대통령은 이날 오전 광주시 옛 전남도청 앞 5·18 민주광장에서 열린 ‘제46주년 5·18민주화운동 기념식’에 참석해 “1980년, 불의한 권력이 철수했던 그 찰나의 공간에서 광주가 온 힘을 끌어모아 꽃피웠던 ‘대동세상’은 2024년, 그 혹독한 겨울밤에 서로의 체온으로 민주주의를 지켜내는 ‘빛의 혁명’으로 부활했다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 그러면서 “이 자리를 빌려, 민주주의를 위해 기꺼이 자신을 내던졌던 오월 민주 영령들의 고귀한 넋 앞에 머리 숙여 무한한 존경과 깊은 애도의 마음을 표한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee repeatedly emphasized the need to incorporate the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement into the Constitution. He stated, "We must proudly inscribe the democratic ideals of the May 18 Democratization Movement onto the Constitution of the Republic of Korea, so that the spirit of May—a driving force that proved national sovereignty and a source of pride in modern Korean history—can take deeper root in our society." He added, "As this is an ongoing promise to the people from all political circles, transcending political interests, I earnestly request bipartisan cooperation and resolution from both the ruling and opposition parties." This drew applause from the attendees. (이 대통령은 헌법에 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 담아야 한다고 거듭 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “국민 주권을 증명한 원동력이자, 대한민국 현대사의 자부심인 5월 정신이 우리 사회에 더 단단히 뿌리내릴 수 있도록, 5⸱18민주화운동의 민주 이념을 대한민국 헌법 위에 당당히 새겨야 한다”며 “정치적 이해관계를 초월한, 모든 정치권의 지속적인 국민과의 약속인 만큼 여야의 초당적 협력과 결단을 간곡히 요청드린다”고 말했다. 그러자 참석자들 사이에선 박수가 터져나왔다.)

Earlier, six political parties, including the Democratic Party of Korea and excluding the People Power Party, attempted to process a constitutional amendment bill containing the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement in the plenary session. However, due to the absence of the People Power Party, the quorum for voting was not met, and the vote failed. The bill ultimately fell through on the 8th. (앞서 국민의힘을 제외한 더불어민주당 등 6개 정당은 5·18 민주화운동 정신 등을 담은 헌법개정안의 본회의 처리를 시도했다. 하지만 국민의힘의 불참으로 의결정족수가 충족되지 않아 표결이 성립하지 못했고, 해당 안건은 지난 8일 결국 처리가 무산됐다.)

Furthermore, President Lee stated that he would turn the Jeonnam Provincial Government Office, where the commemoration ceremony was held, into a "living sanctuary of K-democracy for global citizens to learn from and remember together." He said, "The Jeonnam Provincial Government Office was the last site of citizen resistance against illegal state violence. The government will actively support ensuring that the spirit of sacrifice and solidarity, deeply embedded in the Jeonnam Provincial Government Office, is passed down as a point of pride for the Republic of Korea's republican system and as a value for future generations." The May 18 Democracy Square, where the commemoration ceremony was held, underwent restoration work starting in 2019 and officially opened on the day of the ceremony. The May 18 Democracy Square is also a historic site where various rallies were held during the May 18 Democratization Movement, using the square's fountain as a stage. (아울러 이 대통령은 기념식이 열린 전남도청을 “세계시민이 함께 배우고 기억하는 케이(K)-민주주의의 살아있는 성지로 만들겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “전남도청은 불법적 국가폭력에 맞선 최후의 시민 항쟁지였다”며 “전남도청에 오롯이 남겨진 희생과 연대의 정신이 대한민국 공화정의 자부심이자 미래 세대의 가치로 계승될 수 있도록 정부가 적극 뒷받침하겠다”고 말했다. 이날 기념식이 열린 5·18 민주광장은 2019년부터 복원사업이 진행돼 기념식 개최일인 이날 정식 개관했다. 5·18 민주광장은 5·18 민주화운동 당시 광장에 있는 분수대를 연단으로 삼아 각종 집회가 열렸던 역사적 장소이기도 하다.)

President Lee also announced plans to establish a "system for ex officio registration of May 18 democratic contributors." He said, "At the National May 18 Cemetery, which I visited before coming here, lies the late martyr Yang Chang-geun, felled by bullets from martial law troops. This boy of May, who would have felt the pain of his trampled homeland's justice more than anyone, has yet to be fully recognized as a May 18 democratic contributor because he has no direct family to apply for registration on his behalf. Now, the government will become the family for each and every victim of state violence." (이 대통령은 또 ‘5·18 민주유공자 직권등록 제도’를 마련하겠다고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “이곳에 오기 전 들렀던 국립 5·18 민주묘지에는 계엄군의 총탄에 쓰러진 고 양창근 열사가 잠들어 계셨다. 짓밟힌 조국의 정의에 누구보다 아파했을 오월의 소년은, 등록신청을 대신할 직계가족이 없다는 이유로 아직 5·18 민주유공자로 온전히 인정받지 못하고 있다”며 “​이제 정부가 국가폭력 희생자 한 분 한 분의 가족이 되겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk on ‘random talk’: “Lee Jae-myung sitting face-to-face with Takaichi is extreme pro-Japan” (‘아무 말’ 장동혁 “이재명, 다카이치와 마주앉는 것은 극단적 친일”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, said regarding the South Korea-Japan summit scheduled for the 19th, “According to Lee Jae-myung’s past claims, just sitting face-to-face with Takaichi itself is ‘extreme pro-Japan’.” He disparaged the summit by addressing the two nations’ leaders by name only, suggesting that “Lee Jae-myung, who used to sing ‘Death Song’ at every election, is meeting with a Japanese right-wing figure.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 오는 19일 열리는 한-일 정상회담과 관련해 “과거 이재명의 주장대로라면 다카이치와 마주앉는 것 자체가 ‘극단적 친일’”이라고 말했다. 두 나라 정상을 이름만으로 호칭하면서 “선거 때마다 ‘죽창가’를 부르던 이재명이 일본 우익 인사를 만난다”는 식으로 정상회담을 폄훼한 것이다.)

Representative Jang posted on Facebook on the 18th, stating, “Takaichi is a representative right-wing figure in Japanese politics. Last month, she sent a ritual offering to Yasukuni Shrine, and this year, the Japanese government approved high school textbooks that describe ‘Dokdo as Japanese territory’ and frame ‘forced mobilization’ as ‘recruitment’.” (장 대표는 18일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “다카이치는 일본 정계에서도 대표적인 우익 인사로, 지난 달에도 야스쿠니 신사에 공물을 봉납했고, 올해 일본 정부는 ‘독도는 일본 땅’ 이라고 기재하고, ‘강제동원’을 ‘모집’이라고 서술한 고등학교 교과서들을 검정에서 통과시켰다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

He continued, “Whenever the conservative government held a South Korea-Japan summit, Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party never stopped making strong demands, such as ‘Get an apology for historical issues,’ ‘Clarify the Dokdo issue,’ and ‘Stop the discharge of treated water from Fukushima.’ Yet, after all that, when he himself went to Japan, he didn’t even bring up historical issues or Dokdo at the table and even came back after happily playing the drums.” (그는 “이재명과 민주당은 보수정부가 한일 정상회담을 할 때마다 ‘과거사 사과 받아라’, ‘독도 문제 확실히 하라’, ‘ 후쿠시마 처리수 방류 중지시키라’며 강경한 요구를 멈추지 않았다”며 “그래놓고 정작 본인은 일본 가서 과거사·독도는 아예 테이블에 올리지도 않고 신나게 드럼까지 치고 왔다”고 말했다.)

Representative Jang also wrote, “The intention behind holding a South Korea-Japan summit right before the election is clearly visible. Nonetheless, since we’ve decided to hold the summit, we must properly safeguard national interests. It might be good to learn how to rescue our ships and sailors in the Strait of Hormuz. Takaichi directly called the Iranian president and rescued Japanese ships.” (장 대표는 또 “굳이 선거를 코 앞에 두고 한일 정상회담을 가지는 그 의도가 무엇인지 뻔히 들여다 보인다. 어쨌거나 정상회담을 하기로 했으니, 국익만큼은 제대로 챙겨야 한다”며 “호르무즈해협의 우리 선박과 선원을 구해내는 방법을 배우는 것도 좋겠다. 다카이치는 이란 대통령과 직접 통화해서 일본 선박 구해냈다”고 썼다.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government "Plans to launch DNA analysis of remains from 'Josei Coal Mine' where 136 Koreans perished" (정부 “조선인 136명 희생 ‘조세이 탄광’ 유해 DNA 감정 착수 계획”)
item.description:
The government announced on the 18th that it plans to initiate DNA analysis to identify the remains excavated from the 'Josei Coal Mine' in Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. (정부는 일본 야마구치현 ‘조세이 탄광’에서 발굴된 유해의 신원 확인을 위한 디엔에이(DNA) 감정에 착수할 계획이라고 18일 밝혔다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety explained in a joint press release that they intend to conduct DNA analysis on the remains excavated in August of last year and February of this year. (외교부와 행정안전부는 이날 공동보도자료를 통해 지난해 8월과 올해 2월 발굴된 유해를 대상으로 디엔에이 감정을 할 계획이라고 설명했다.)

South Korea and Japan agreed in January during the South Korea-Japan summit held in Nara, Japan, between President Lee Jae-myung and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi to push forward with DNA analysis of the Josei Coal Mine remains. The related idea was first proposed by Prime Minister Takaichi, and has been evaluated as creating a small breakthrough in the history issues between South Korea and Japan. The government added, "Since the January summit, we have held working-level consultations between diplomatic authorities to discuss the specific procedures and methods for the DNA analysis (of the Josei Coal Mine remains)," and "We will continue to cooperate with the Japanese side so that DNA analysis and identification can be carried out swiftly." (한일 양국은 지난 1월 일본 나라에서 열린 이재명 대통령과 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리의 한-일 정상회담에서 조세이 탄광 디엔에이 감정 추진에 합의한 바 있다. 관련 아이디어는 다카이치 총리가 먼저 제안했으며, 한일 과거사 문제에서 작은 돌파구를 만들었다는 평가가 나왔다. 정부는 “1월 정상회담 이후 외교당국 간 실무협의를 거쳐 (조세이 탄광 유해) 디엔에이 감정의 구체적인 절차와 방법에 대해 협의해 왔다”며 “디엔에이 감정과 신원 확인이 신속히 이뤄질 수 있도록 일본 측과 지속 협력해 나갈 예정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

On the 19th and 20th, Prime Minister Takaichi is scheduled to visit President Lee's hometown of Andong for a South Korea-Japan summit, and it is a point of interest whether the two leaders will again discuss the issue of the remains of Korean victims from the Josei Coal Mine and propose more advanced measures during this meeting. (19~20일 다카이치 총리가 이 대통령의 고향 안동을 방문해 한-일 정상회담이 열릴 예정인데, 두 정상이 이번 회담에서 조세이 탄광 조선인 희생자 유골 문제에 대해 다시 논의하고 좀 더 진전된 방안을 내놓을지도 관심사다.)

The Josei Coal Mine flooding disaster occurred on February 3, 1942, when seawater flooded the Josei undersea coal mine, resulting in the deaths of 136 forcibly mobilized Koreans and 47 Japanese who were suffering under harsh labor. The victims' remains were left abandoned on the seabed for over 80 years, until a Japanese civic group 'The Meeting to Record the Josei Coal Mine Flooding Accident in History,' formed in 1991, conducted underwater surveys with its own funds. Subsequently, four pieces were first discovered in August of last year, and an additional piece of the victim's remains from the flooding accident was excavated in January of this year. (조세이 탄광 수몰 사건은 1942년 2월3일 조세이 해저탄광에 바닷물이 들어와 강제동원된 채 가혹한 노동에 시달리던 조선인 136명과 일본인 47명이 숨진 참사다. 희생자들의 유해는 80여년간 해저에 방치됐다가, 1991년 결성된 일본 시민단체 ‘조세이 탄광 수몰사고를 역사에 새기는 모임’이 자체 자금으로 수중 탐사를 이어온 끝에 지난해 8월 처음으로 4점이 발견된 후 올해 1월 수몰사고의 희생자 유해 1점이 추가로 발굴됐다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Song Eon-seok: "I Won't Go to Gwangju Because It's Dirty"… As Controversy Grows, He Clarifies It Was 'Because It's Heartbreaking' (송언석 “5·18 광주 더러버서 안 가”…논란 커지자 ‘서러워서’ 해명)
item.description:
Controversy is brewing after it was revealed that Song Eon-seok, the floor leader of the People Power Party, said he would not visit Gwangju on the 18th, the day of the 46th anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising memorial ceremony, because "it's dirty (더러버서)." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표가 제46주년 5·18 민주화운동 기념식이 열린 18일 광주 방문을 하지 않은 데 대해 “더러버서(더러워서) 안 간다”고 말한 사실이 알려지며 논란이 일고 있다.)

On that day, after finishing a press briefing on issues related to the June 3 local elections, Song said during a tea time with reporters in response to questions about the atmosphere at campaign sites, "Every site I go to, they all go 'wow.' Would I go to a place where they call me 'that Mr. Lee' when we're there?" He added, "Even if I go to Gwangju, there are people protesting, but we also have our supporters, so they would cheer me on like this there too." When asked about Deputy Floor Leader Jang Dong-hyeok attending the May 18 memorial ceremony, he replied with a laugh, "Who knows what might happen today. That's why I'm not going—because it's dirty." <<> In response, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae posted on Facebook that day with the title "Did I misread it?" saying, "I thought the PPP figure meant he wasn't going because the weather was hot (더워서, 'deo-weo-seo', homophone). But that wasn't it," and criticized, "What an incorrigible group." <<> An official from the floor leader's office explained, "Floor Leader Song said he wasn't going because 'it's heartbreaking (서러워서, 'seo-reo-wo-seo'),'" clarifying that "May 18 is a day for everyone, but just like last year when Deputy Leader Jang couldn't pay his respects and was blocked, it's heartbreaking not to be welcomed." <<> After media reports emerged, the floor leader's office stated, "Floor Leader Song Eon-seok did not use that expression. We deeply regret this report based on a private tea time without verifying the facts, and we will take legal action." <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (송 원내대표는 이날 6·3 지방선거 관련 현안 기자간담회를 마친 뒤 기자들과의 티타임 자리에서 선거 현장 분위기와 관련한 물음에 “내가 가는 현장은 전부 다 ‘와’ 한다. 우리가 갔는데 거기서 ‘이씨’ 이러는 장소를 가겠느냐”라고 말했다. 이어 “심지어 광주를 가더라도 데모하는 사람들이 있지만, 우리 지지자들도 있으니까 거기서도 막 이렇게(지지) 할 텐데”라고 덧붙였다. 장동혁 대표가 5·18 기념식에 참석하는 데 대한 질문엔 “모르지, 오늘 어떤 상황이 생길지”라며 “그래서 나는 더러버서 안 간다”라고 웃으며 답했다.)

item.title: President Lee berates "too inadequate" measures at Jeju Air disaster recovery site (이 대통령, 제주항공 참사 수습 현장서 “조치 너무 부실” 질타)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th visited the site where the remains of victims of the 'December 29 Jeju Air passenger plane disaster' were being recovered, and criticized government officials, saying, "Shouldn't we speed up the recovery as much as possible for the sake of the bereaved families and the national economy?" (이재명 대통령이 18일 ‘12·29 제주항공 여객기 참사’ 희생자 유해 수습 현장을 찾아 “유족이나 국민 경제를 위해 최대한 (수습을) 빨리해야 할 것 아니냐”며 정부 담당자들을 질책했다.)

President Lee visited the accident site at Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province, where the Jeju Air passenger plane disaster occurred, that afternoon. The government has been conducting a full-scale re-search of the accident site since the 13th of last month, following a barrage of criticism that the initial recovery was inadequate, as some victims' remains were found mixed in with debris at the site over a year and two months after the accident occurred. (이 대통령은 이날 오후 제주항공 여객기 참사가 벌어진 전남 무안공항 내 사고 현장을 방문했다. 정부는 일부 희생자의 유해가 현장 잔해물에 뒤섞여 사고 발생 1년2개월이 지난 뒤에 발견되는 등 초기 수습이 미비했다는 지적이 빗발치자, 지난달 13일부터 사고 현장에 대한 전면적인 재수색을 진행하고 있다.)

While receiving a briefing on the progress of the re-search from Kim Gyu-hyung, a standing member of the Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board (ARAIB), President Lee questioned, "It's been delayed far too much... Why wasn't the on-site recovery or such done properly from the beginning?" (이 대통령은 김규형 항공·철도사고조사위원회(항철위) 상임위원으로부터 재수색 작업 현황을 보고받던 중 “너무 많이 (작업이) 지연됐다”라며 “당초에 현장 수습이나 이런 게 왜 제대로 안 돼 있었느냐”고 따져 물었다.)

President Lee stated, "Ensure this re-search is thorough, and also examine whether the existing manuals are problematic. It doesn't seem like the existing manuals were followed diligently either." He then added, "To prevent this from happening again, does it make sense to conduct the accident investigation twice? The on-site recovery measures were far too inadequate, that's the problem, isn't it? It's careless," reiterating his criticism. (이 대통령은 “이번 재수색은 철저히 하고 기존 매뉴얼이 문제가 있는지도 살펴보시라”라며 “기존 매뉴얼도 충실히 잘 지킨 것 같진 않다”라고 말했다. 이어 “앞으로 이런 일이 벌어지지 않게, 사고 조사를 두번씩이나 하는 게 말이 되느냐”며 “현장 수습 조치가 너무 부실했던 게 문제는 문제 아니냐. 무심하다”고 거듭 지적했다.)

Bereaved families at the site demanded a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident. When some family members raised issues regarding the lack of expertise of the investigators, President Lee responded, "Couldn't we also leave the judgment on matters like aviation accidents and aircraft defects to people with expertise?" This suggests entrusting civilian experts with such investigations to shorten the investigation period and ensure credibility. President Lee said, "Consider entrusting the investigation entirely to a specialized group. If the bereaved families or victims have any doubts, disclose everything and inform them. Misunderstandings arise from not knowing." (현장에 있던 유가족들은 사고 원인에 대한 철저한 진상규명을 요구했다. 일부 유가족들이 조사관의 전문성 부족 등에 대한 문제를 제기하자, 이 대통령은 “항공사고, 기체결함 등의 부분에 대해 전문성을 가진 사람들한테 판단을 맡길 수도 있지 않겠느냐”고 말하기도 했다. 전문성을 가진 민간에 사고 원인 조사 등을 맡겨 조사 기간을 단축하고, 신뢰성을 담보하자는 취지다. 이 대통령은 “전문 집단에 (조사를) 아예 맡기는 것도 검토해보라”며 “유가족들이나 피해자들이 혹시라도 의문을 가지면 다 공개해서 알려주시라. 모르니까 오해가 생긴다”라고 했다.)

To pleas from the bereaved families like "It's too hard," and "Please let us return to normal life," President Lee replied, "I will take good care of it." The family members responded with "We trust you," and "Thank you." (이 대통령은 “너무 힘들다”, “일상으로 돌아가게 해달라”라는 유가족의 호소에 “잘 챙겨보겠다”라고 답했다. 유가족들은 “믿겠다”, “감사하다”고 호응했다.)

Before visiting the remains recovery site, President Lee laid flowers at the joint memorial altar for the disaster victims set up inside the Muan International Airport passenger terminal and observed a moment of silence for the victims. (이 대통령은 유해 수습 현장을 방문하기에 앞서 무안공항 여객터미널 안에 마련된 참사 희생자 합동분향소에 헌화하고 희생자들을 향해 묵념했다.)

Shim Woo-sam Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Holds Talks with Ahn Cheol-soo… Following Yoo Seung-min and Lee Jun-seok, Does He Dream of Reformist Conservative Alliance? (오세훈, 안철수와 간담회…유승민·이준석 이어 개혁보수 연대 꿈꾸나)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, is broadening his outreach by engaging with centrist and pragmatic figures both inside and outside the party, targeting the floating voter base. After recent meetings with former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Seung-min and Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok, he held a discussion with lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo on the 18th, putting youth job issues at the forefront. (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 당 안팎의 중도·실용 노선 성향 인사들과 함께 일정을 소화하며 부동층을 겨냥한 외연 확장에 보폭을 넓히고 있다. 최근 유승민 국민의힘 전 의원, 이준석 개혁신당 대표 등과 만난 데 이어 18일에는 안철수 의원과 간담회를 열고 청년 일자리 문제를 전면에 내세웠다.)

That day, Candidate Oh, along with lawmaker Ahn, visited the Seoul AI & Software Academy (SeSAC) Yeongdeungpo Campus, where they met young people who had completed the training program. "In the AI era, helping young people cultivate skills and use them for employment or startups is the most critical area for securing Seoul's competitiveness," Oh said. "I arranged this meeting to invite lawmaker Ahn, who has the keenest insight in this field, to hear his words of encouragement." He further emphasized, "I plan to continue expanding contacts with those who can add strength, boost the election atmosphere, and join hands to build Seoul's future together." Lawmaker Ahn responded, "What Mayor Oh focuses on most is young people," and added, "Coming here today, I could feel that he doesn't just talk—he actually creates facilities like this, helps people get jobs, and carries out activities with sincere dedication." Ahn participated in the National Assembly's impeachment vote against then-President Yoon Suk-yeol in December 2024 and has since urged a halt to internal disputes over the "break with Yoon" controversy, calling for a focus on people's livelihoods. <<> On the 14th, the day of candidate registration, Candidate Oh met with former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Seung-min. On the 16th, he held a youth housing site meeting with Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok and Seoul mayoral candidate Kim Jeong-cheol in a studio apartment in Gongneung-dong, Nowon-gu, signaling the potential for a real estate policy alliance. Appearing on Channel A's YouTube broadcast that day, Oh stated, "As for policy cooperation with the Reform Party, we'll do everything we can together." However, regarding the possibility of a single candidacy, he only mentioned, "I think it would be good if it happens." <<> Analyses suggest that Oh's moves are not only aimed at the June 3 local elections but also at a potential restructuring of the conservative camp after the elections. He continues to maintain a "distance" from the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, and some view this as a plan to pursue an alliance among reformist conservative forces and even challenge for the next party leadership after the local elections. <<> A two-term lawmaker from the People Power Party said, "As a mayor, he has no choice but to act by assuming both the scenario of winning and losing the election," adding, "In the local elections, he will focus on conservative integration and unity, and afterward, he will likely try to become the focal point of a reformist conservative alliance." <<> Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (오 후보는 이날 안 의원과 함께 서울 영등포구에 있는 청년취업사관학교(SeSAC) 영등포캠퍼스에서 교육을 수료한 청년들을 만나 “에이아이(AI) 시대에 청년들에게 능력을 배양하고 취업이나 창업에 쓸 수 있도록 도움을 주는 건 서울의 경쟁력을 확보하는 데 가장 중요한 영역”이라며 “이 방면에 가장 혜안을 가진 안 의원을 모시고 격려의 말씀 듣는 자리를 마련했다”고 말했다. 그는 이어 “힘을 보태주고 선거 분위기를 띄워주는 분들, 손을 잡고 함께 서울의 미래를 만들어갈 수 있는 분들과 계속 접촉면을 확대할 생각”이라고 강조했다. 안 의원도 “오 시장이 가장 중점적으로 생각하는 것이 청년들”이라며 “오늘 와보니 (오 후보는) 말로 그치는 것이 아니라 실제로 이렇게 시설을 만들고, 사람들 취업시키고, 활동을 열심히 진심을 갖고 하시는구나 느낄 수 있었다”고 화답했다. 안 의원은 2024년 12월 윤석열 당시 대통령에 대한 국회 탄핵안 표결에 참여했고, 당내 절윤(윤석열 전 대통령과의 절연) 논란에선 공방을 멈추고 민생에 집중하자는 의견을 내왔다.)

item.title: Chung Won-oh Focuses on Han River Belt, Crafting Tailored Pledges on Property Tax Cuts and Redevelopment (보유세 감면·재개발 맞춤 공약 발굴…한강벨트 공들이는 정원오)
item.description:
<<>> Chung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, is pursuing a strategy of intensively targeting the Han River Belt (Mapo, Yongsan, Seongdong, Gwangjin, Yeongdeungpo, Dongjak, and Jung districts). His calculation is to secure the votes of residents in these areas, who are sensitive to real estate policies, and to create a springboard for a rebound in the race against Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, whose gap has narrowed. ()

A source from Candidate Chung's campaign told The Hankyoreh on the 18th, "As young people (who strongly support the Democratic Party) move to Gyeonggi Province, Seoul's demographic composition is increasingly becoming unfavorable for the Democratic Party," adding, "The focus is on the Han River Belt." The source further stated, "We plan to emphasize that Candidate Chung is the right person to execute development strategies and continue to show an image that expands to moderate voters." It is highly likely that from the first day of the election campaign on the 21st, schedules will be centered around these areas. Another campaign source also said, "Victory in the Han River Belt is a condition for the Democratic Party candidate's victory," and "For moderate voters in Seoul or those living in the Han River Belt, satisfaction with administrative effectiveness and issues like redevelopment and reconstruction will be important." ( 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보가 한강벨트(마포·용산·성동·광진·영등포·동작·중구)를 집중공략하는 전략을 펴고 있다. 부동산 정책에 민감한 이들 지역 표심을 확보해 격차가 좁아진 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보와의 대결 구도에서 반등의 발판을 만들겠다는 계산이다.)

The Han River Belt is considered a representative "swing voter" region where votes shift according to real estate policies. Before 2020, the Democratic Party-affiliated parties had a dominant vote share, but the atmosphere changed amid rising real estate prices, earning it the nickname "Comprehensive Real Estate Tax Belt" (referring to the many homes subject to the comprehensive real estate tax). From the 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election to the 2022 20th presidential election and local elections, the People Power Party candidate prevailed, but in the 2024 22nd general election, held after former President Yoon Suk-yeol's approval ratings plummeted, the Democratic Party again won in 8 out of 11 districts, excluding Mapo Gap, Yongsan, and Dongjak Eul. In last year's 21st presidential election, Democratic Party presidential candidate Lee Jae-myung outperformed People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo in 6 out of 7 districts except Yongsan. ( 정 후보 캠프 관계자는 18일 한겨레에 “(민주당 지지세가 높은) 젊은 층이 경기도로 이주하며 서울시의 인구 구성이 점점 민주당에 쉽지 않은 쪽으로 바뀌고 있다”며 “중점을 두는 데는 한강벨트”라고 했다. 이 관계자는 이어 “정 후보가 개발 전략을 펼 적임자임을 강조하고, 중도층으로 확장하는 모습을 계속 보여줄 계획”이라고 했다. 선거운동 개시 첫날인 21일부터 이들 지역을 중심으로 일정을 진행할 가능성이 크다. 또 다른 캠프 관계자도 “한강벨트의 승리는 민주당 후보의 승리 조건”이라며 “서울의 중도층이나 한강벨트에 사는 유권자들은 행정의 효능감, 재개발·재건축 같은 현안들에 대한 만족도가 중요할 것”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Chung is also highlighting real estate pledges targeting the Gangnam 4 districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, and Gangdong), which are weak areas for Democratic Party support. On the 8th, he proposed setting up a special committee within the party to address issues in the "Gangnam 4 districts," and on the 13th, he announced a pledge to "reduce property holding taxes for single-homeowners without income" to target the middle class and retired generations with a single high-priced home. On the 29th of last month, he unveiled a "smooth development" pledge to shorten the average redevelopment project period from 15 years to 10 years through amendments to the Act on the Improvement of Urban Areas and Residential Environments, and on the 7th and 8th, he visited redevelopment sites in Gangnam areas like Apgujeong and Gaepo, emphasizing administrative consistency to reassure voters in these regions. ( 한강벨트는 부동산 정책에 따라 표심이 움직인 대표적인 ‘스윙보터’ 지역으로 꼽힌다. 2020년 이전엔 민주당 계열 정당의 득표율이 우세했지만, 부동산 가격 상승 국면에서 분위기가 바뀌며 ‘종부세벨트’(종합부동산세가 부과되는 주택이 많다는 뜻)라는 별칭이 따라붙었다. 2021년 서울시장 보궐선거부터 2022년 20대 대선, 지방선거에서 모두 국민의힘 후보가 우세했으나 윤석열 전 대통령의 지지율이 추락한 뒤 치러진 2024년 22대 총선에서는 다시 민주당이 11개 선거구 중 마포갑·용산·동작을을 제외한 8개 선거구에서 승리했다. 지난해 21대 대선에서 용산을 제외한 6개 구에서 이재명 당시 민주당 대선 후보가 김문수 당시 국민의힘 대선 후보를 앞섰다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr ( 정 후보는 민주당 지지율 취약 지역인 강남4구(강남·서초·송파·강동구)를 겨냥한 부동산 공약도 부각하고 있다. 지난 8일 ‘강남4구’ 현안 해결을 위한 당내 특위 설치를 제안했고, 13일에는 고가 1주택을 보유한 중산층과 은퇴 세대를 공략하기 위한 ‘소득 없는 1주택자를 위한 부동산보유세 감면’ 공약을 발표하기도 했다. 그는 지난달 29일 도시 및 주거환경정비법(도정법) 개정 등을 통해 재개발 사업기간을 평균 15년에서 10년까지 줄이는 ‘착착개발’ 공약을 내놨고, 지난 7~8일에는 압구정·개포 등 강남권 재개발 현장을 찾아 행정 일관성을 강조하며 이 지역 유권자들을 안심시키려 했다.)

item.title: Government Releases Unification White Paper Defining 'Two Peaceful States' (정부, ‘평화적 두국가’ 규정한 통일백서 냈다)
item.description:
The first unification white paper of the Lee Jae-myung administration has been released, which defines the two Koreas as 'de facto two states' and explicitly states the pursuit of a 'peaceful coexistence' policy rather than hostility. This is interpreted as acknowledging the reality that North Korea has recently solidified inter-Korean relations as de facto hostile two-state relations, and conveying the intent to continue mutual respect and dialogue on that basis. (남북을 ‘사실상 두 국가’로 규정하며 적대가 아닌 ‘평화공존’ 정책 추구를 명시한 이재명 정부 첫 통일백서가 나왔다. 북한이 최근 남북을 사실상의 적대적 두 국가 관계로 기정사실화한 것을 현실로 인정하고, 그 바탕에서 상호 존중과 대화를 이어가겠다는 뜻을 담은 것으로 풀이된다.)

The white paper also highlights the restoration of the September 19 inter-Korean military agreement as a key task. The Ministry of Unification announced on the 18th that it had published the 2026 unification white paper under the subtitle 'Records of Peaceful Coexistence on the Korean Peninsula 2025.' The ministry emphasized efforts to overcome the state of complete severance in inter-Korean relations at the time of the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration in June of last year, and to transition from hostility and confrontation to peaceful coexistence, explaining that the document carries the significance of a policy direction shift. ( 백서는 9·19 남북 군사합의 복원도 중점 과제로 꼽았다. 통일부는 18일 ‘2025 한반도 평화공존의 기록들’이란 부제가 달린 2026년 통일백서를 발간했다고 밝혔다. 통일부는 지난해 6월 이재명 정부 출범 당시 완전한 단절 상태에 놓였던 남북 관계를 극복하고, 적대와 대결을 평화공존으로 전환하기 위해 노력해온 점을 강조하고, 정책 방향 전환의 의미를 담았다고 설명했다.)

The white paper includes the need to transition from North Korea's claim of 'hostile two-state relations' to 'peaceful two-state relations oriented toward unification.' This aims to create a relationship of peaceful coexistence between the two Koreas while pursuing unification, taking into account the reality that the two Koreas effectively exist as 'two states.' North Korea amended its constitution in March, adding a territorial clause and explicitly designating South Korea as the 'Republic of Korea,' thereby codifying inter-Korean relations as a 'two-state' relationship. However, the constitution did not include phrases hostile to South Korea. Reflecting this reality, the government specified 'peaceful two-state relations' and viewed that this does not contradict the existing inter-Korean relationship defined as a 'special relationship oriented toward unification' under the 1991 Basic Agreement between North and South Korea. The white paper states, "This inherits the peaceful coexistence policies pursued by successive governments for 35 years since the adoption of the Inter-Korean Basic Agreement." It also proposed three principles for forming peaceful two-state relations: △respect for the North Korean regime △non-pursuit of absorption unification △non-promotion of hostile acts. <<> This marks a complete shift from the Yoon Suk-yeol administration's North Korea policy, which prioritized freedom and unification, pressured the North Korean regime, and emphasized nuclear deterrence under the 'Audacious Initiative.' The Yoon administration's 2025 unification white paper, published in May of last year, criticized North Korea's hostile two-state relationship definition and focused on a unification vision led by South Korea. It also stated that to 'denuclearize North Korea,' it would 'deter' North Korea's nuclear threats, 'discourage' nuclear development, and 'resolve' the North Korean nuclear issue through dialogue. <<> In contrast, this first unification white paper of the Lee Jae-myung administration presents a three-step denuclearization solution of 'cessation-reduction-dismantlement,' considering the reality of North Korea's nuclear development. It also sets the goal of realizing a 'Korean Peninsula without war and nuclear weapons,' adopting a comprehensive approach of 'exchange-normalization of relations-denuclearization' as its promotion strategy. <<> The Ministry of Unification noted that the Lee Jae-myung administration's suspension of leafleting and loudspeaker broadcasts, which were conducted under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, was a 'preemptive tension reduction measure that put peace into practice first,' and attributed significance to changes such as 'the restoration of peace in border areas.' <<> The white paper presents the restoration of the September 19 military agreement as a key priority task. The September 19 military agreement, signed at the Pyongyang inter-Korean summit in September 2018 during the Moon Jae-in administration, has experienced fluctuations depending on the administration. The agreement aimed to ease military tensions, such as reducing tensions in the Demilitarized Zone and establishing no-fly zones around the Military Demarcation Line, but its effect was suspended in June 2024 under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. After the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, it promised preemptive and phased restoration of the agreement. <<> Compared to the previous white paper, this one shows a decrease in references to North Korean human rights (from 288 to 47) and freedom (from 118 to 16), while the frequency of words such as peace or peaceful coexistence (from 108 to 627) and talks or dialogue (from 50 to 114) increased. The white paper also changed the term 'North Korean defectors' to 'Bukhyangmin' (Northward-bound people). <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr ( 백서는 북한의 ‘적대적 두 국가 관계’ 주장에 대해 ‘통일을 지향하는 평화적 두 국가 관계’로의 전환이 필요하다는 점을 담았다. 사실상 남북이 ‘두 국가’로 존재하는 현실을 고려해 남북을 통일을 지향하면서 평화롭게 공존하는 관계로 만들겠다는 것이다. 북한은 지난 3월 헌법을 개정하면서 영토 조항을 신설하고, 남한을 ‘대한민국’으로 명시하면서 남북을 ‘두 국가’ 관계로 명문화했다. 다만 헌법에 남한을 적대시하는 문구는 담지 않았다. 정부는 이런 현실을 반영해 ‘평화적 두 국가 관계’를 명시했고, 이는 1991년 남북기본합의에 따른 ‘통일을 지향하는 특수 관계’라는 기존 남북 관계 규정과도 배치되지 않는다고 봤다. 백서는 “남북기본합의서 채택 이래 역대 정부가 35년 동안 추진한 평화공존 정책을 계승하는 것”이라고 명시했다. 백서는 평화적 두 국가 관계 형성을 위해 △북한 체제 존중 △흡수통일 불추구 △적대행위 불추진 등의 3원칙도 제시했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Jae-myung is extremely pro-Japan"... Song Eon-seok skipped May 18 commemoration because it was "disgusting" (장동혁 “이재명, 극단적 친일”...송언석, 5·18 기념식에 더러버서 안가)
item.description:
On the 46th anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted a series of harsh criticisms on social media targeting President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party, calling them "extremely pro-Japan" and saying "Lee Jae-myung is at the forefront of a South Korea heading toward dictatorship." On the same day, it was revealed that People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok said he "didn't go to the May 18 Democratic Uprising commemoration in Gwangju because it was disgusting (dirty)," sparking controversy. <<> Jang posted on Facebook regarding the upcoming South Korea-Japan summit, writing, "Takaichi is a prominent right-wing figure even in Japanese politics. Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party, who sang the 'Death March' during every election, meet with her even though, according to Lee's past claims, just sitting opposite Takaichi itself is 'extreme pro-Japan'." He referred to the heads of the two states by their first names alone and labeled Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae as a "right-wing figure." <<> Immediately after attending the May 18 commemoration in Gwangju, Jang wrote, "Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party always invoke the spirit of May 18, but to them, May 18 is not a value to be upheld—it's merely a tool for expanding power." <<> Amid this, during a tea meeting with reporters at the National Assembly on the same morning, floor leader Song Eon-seok was asked about Jang's attendance at the May 18 commemoration in Gwangju. He replied, "I don't know what might happen (in Gwangju) today," adding, "That's why I'm not going—it's disgusting." As controversy grew, an official from the party's floor leader's office clarified, "He said he wasn't going because it was 'pitiful,' meaning he felt unwelcome and sad." Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae criticized the party as "truly a hopeless group." <<> Reporters: Yoo Young-jae and Jang Na-rae young@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 5·18민주화운동 46주년인 18일 “극단적 친일”, “독재로 가는 대한민국. 그 맨 앞에 서 있는 이재명” 등 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당을 거칠게 비난하는 메시지를 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에 잇달아 올렸다. 같은 날 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표도 광주에서 열린 5·18민주화운동 기념식에 “더러버서(더러워서) 안 간다”고 말한 사실이 알려져 논란이 일고 있다.)

item.title: 'Missing Rebar in GTX Construction' Sparks Proxy War for Seoul Mayoral Election in National Assembly... Ruling Party Claims "Systematic Cover-Up," Opposition Says "Spreading False Information" (‘GTX 역사 철근 누락’ 놓고 국회서 서울시장 선거 대리전…여 “조직적 은폐” 야 “허위사실 유포”)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties engaged in a fierce parliamentary debate over whether Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party (PPP) candidate for Seoul mayor, bears responsibility for the "missing rebar construction" in the Great Train Express (GTX)-A Samsung Station construction section. (여야가 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-에이(A) 삼성역 공사 구간의 ‘철근 누락 시공’과 관련해 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보의 책임 여부를 두고 국회에서 거센 공방을 벌였다.)

At a plenary session of the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee held on the 18th, the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) raised the issue of Candidate Oh's liability, claiming that the Seoul Metropolitan Government, despite being aware of the missing rebar, delayed reporting it to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) for about five months, calling it a "systematic cover-up by the Seoul city government." In response, the PPP countered by pointing out that the city had identified the issue and notified the National Railroad Corporation, an agency under MOLIT, arguing that "the DPK is spreading false information." <<> On that day, the Seoul city government submitted a document to the committee stating that it had officially notified the National Railroad Corporation via official letters about the construction management interim reports (containing the missing rebar information) on November 13 and December 12 of last year, and January 16 of this year. In response, PPP lawmaker Cho Eun-hee attacked, saying, "The DPK or Candidate Jung Won-oh (DPK Seoul mayoral candidate) are spreading false information and rumors to hide their own incompetence." DPK lawmaker Mo Gyeong-jong then countered by pointing out that among the 400-page report, the part concerning the missing rebar was only a single page, asking, "You call this a proper report, just a one-page summary tailored to the Seoul city government's convenience?" <<> The DPK repeatedly raised suspicions that Candidate Oh and the Seoul city government attempted to hide the incident ahead of the election, noting that the city reported the missing rebar to MOLIT on the 29th of last month, just two days after Candidate Oh registered as a preliminary candidate. Lawmaker Oh Gi-hyung commented, "Didn't Candidate Oh 'muzzle' the issue, and then, when his duties were suspended due to his candidate registration, the truth came out, and they finally reported it?" <<> On the same day, the PPP filed a complaint with the police against Candidate Jung Won-oh, citing his remarks during an explanation of an assault conviction from 31 years ago and his attacks on Candidate Oh using phrases like "Seoul city government's safety insensitivity" regarding the missing rebar, accusing him of spreading false information respectively. Meanwhile, Candidate Oh appeared on Channel A's YouTube channel and stated, "I heard that person (Candidate Jung) served as the propaganda director of the National Student Representative Council (Jeondaehyeop). It feels like he's now showcasing the skills he showed off when he was young." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 18일 열린 국회 행정안전위원회 전체회의에서 더불어민주당은 서울시가 철근 누락을 파악하고도 이를 5개월여 뒤인 지난달 국토교통부에 보고한 것에 대해 “서울시의 조직적 은폐”라며 오 후보 책임론을 제기했다. 이에 국민의힘은 서울시가 해당 사실을 파악하고 이를 국토부 산하 기관인 국가철도공단에 통보했다는 점을 들어 “민주당이 허위사실을 유포하고 있다”고 맞섰다. )

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "Judgment on the Insurrection Nomination"... Jang Dong-hyuk Enters Amid Citizen Protests (정청래 “내란 공천 심판”…장동혁, 시민 항의 받으며 입장)
item.description:
<<>> After taking office, President Lee Jae-myung attended the 5·18 Democratization Movement commemoration ceremony for the first time alongside the leadership of both the ruling and opposition parties, honoring the spirit of the citizens and students of Gwangju and consoling the families of the victims. After paying respects at the National 5·18 Democratic Cemetery, President Lee's eyes reddened. ()

President Lee, accompanied by his wife Kim Hye-kyung, attended the 46th anniversary commemoration ceremony of the democratization movement held on the 18th at the 5·18 Democracy Square in front of the former Jeonnam Provincial Government Building. It was the first time in six years that the ceremony, usually held at the National 5·18 Democratic Cemetery, took place at Democracy Square. The ceremony, held under the theme "May, Embracing the Square" to commemorate the reopening of the former Jeonnam Provincial Government Building—the site of the final struggle of the civilian militia—was attended by President Lee and his wife, the leaders of both ruling and opposition parties, and about 3,000 people, including 5·18 veterans and their families. <<> Before attending the ceremony, President Lee visited the graves of martyrs Park In-bae, Yang Chang-geun, and Kim Myung-sook, laid at the Democratic Cemetery, offering flowers and consoling their families. After paying respects, a scene of President Lee and his wife reddening their eyes was captured. Following the ceremony, President Lee visited the restored former Jeonnam Provincial Government Building and met with Park Young-soon, who made the final broadcast reporting the horrors of Gwangju from the building in the early hours of May 27. As Park recounted the events of 46 years ago and began to cry, President Lee said, "I followed that broadcast on December 3," expressing his gratitude. This referred to his YouTube live broadcast from his car heading to the National Assembly on December 3, 2024, when he was the leader of the Democratic Party, urging citizens to gather at the National Assembly during the declaration of martial law to vote for its repeal. <<> The leadership of both ruling and opposition parties also gathered in full at the ceremony. The Democratic Party of Korea, including its leadership, brought about 70 lawmakers to Gwangju. After paying respects at the Democratic Cemetery, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae told reporters, "If it weren't for the experience and lessons of the 5·18 Democratization Movement—that the past helped the present and the dead saved the living—neither I, President Lee Jae-myung, nor National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik would be alive today (due to the martial law). Seeing the insurrection party, which defends the insurrection and shouts 'Yoon Again,' nominate candidates for insurrection, I prayed to the democratic spirits of Gwangju to surely deliver judgment." <<> Representative Jang Dong-hyuk of the People Power Party entered the ceremony venue through a separate passage amid protests from citizens shouting "Insurrection group." Inside the ceremony hall, he was told by the mother of martyr Moon Jae-hak, the real-life inspiration for the protagonist "Dong-ho" in Han Kang's novel "The Boy is Coming," "You have no right to be here." Kwon Young-guk, the leader of the Justice Party, approached Representative Jang and protested, citing his absence from the vote on the constitutional amendment embodying the spirit of 5·18, saying, "How dare you come here with such cheek?" <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Gwangju/Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr ( 이재명 대통령이 취임 뒤 처음으로 여야 지도부와 함께 5·18 민주화운동 기념식에 참석해 광주의 시민과 학생들의 정신을 기리고, 희생자 유족들을 위로했다. 국립 5·18 민주묘지를 참배한 이 대통령은 눈시울을 붉히기도 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "The Spirit of May 18 Must Be Enshrined in the Constitution... Bipartisan Cooperation Is Essential" (이 대통령 “5·18 정신, 꼭 헌법 수록…여야 초당적 협력을”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 18th, "The spirits of May rescued the living of today on the night of December 3, 2024," and "I will do my utmost to ensure the spirit of May 18 is enshrined in the preamble of the Constitution." (이재명 대통령이 18일 “오월의 영령들이 2024년 12월3일 밤, 오늘의 산 자들을 구했다”며 “5·18 정신이 반드시 헌법 전문에 수록될 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

In his commemorative address at the 46th Anniversary Ceremony of the May 18 Democratization Movement held at the May 18 Democracy Square in front of the former South Jeolla Provincial Government building in Dong-gu, Gwangju, the President stated, "We must proudly inscribe the democratic ideals of the May 18 Democratization Movement into the Constitution of the Republic of Korea, so that the spirit of May—the driving force that proved the sovereignty of the people and the pride of modern Korean history—can take deeper root in our society." President Lee added, "This is a promise that transcends political interests, a continuous pledge by all political circles to the people," calling for bipartisan cooperation from the People Power Party. Earlier, a constitutional amendment bill to include the spirit of May 18 and the Busan-Masan Uprising in the preamble of the Constitution failed to pass at a plenary session on the 8th due to the absence of People Power Party lawmakers. <<> At his first May 18 ceremony since taking office, President Lee emphasized the spirit of May 18, which served as a driving force in overcoming the December 3 insurrection. He said, "In 1980, in that fleeting space where unjust power withdrew, the 'Great Unity World' that Gwangju bloomed with all its might was reborn in 2024 as a 'Revolution of Light,' where people protected democracy with each other's body heat on that harsh winter night." <<> President Lee stressed that the former South Jeolla Provincial Government building, "the final site of citizen resistance against illegal state violence," would be transformed into "a living sanctuary of K-democracy." Noting cases of individuals who could not be recognized as democratic activists for the May 18 movement due to lacking direct relatives to file applications on their behalf, he stated, "We will establish a system for ex-officio registration of May 18 democratic activists to ensure not a single sacrifice is overlooked." The ceremony was attended by leaders from both ruling and opposition parties, including Democratic Party of Korea leader Chung Cheong-rae and People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Gwangju/Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이날 오전 광주시 동구 옛 전남도청 앞 5·18민주광장에서 열린 ‘제46주년 5·18민주화운동 기념식’ 기념사를 통해 “국민 주권을 증명한 원동력이자, 대한민국 현대사의 자부심인 5월 정신이 우리 사회에 더 단단히 뿌리내릴 수 있도록 5·18민주화운동의 민주 이념을 대한민국 헌법 위에 당당히 새겨야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “정치적 이해관계를 초월한, 모든 정치권의 지속적인 국민과의 약속”이라며 국민의힘을 향해 초당적 협력을 요청했다. 앞서 5·18 정신과 부마항쟁 정신을 헌법 전문에 담은 헌법 개정안은 국민의힘 의원들의 불참 탓에 지난 8일 본회의 처리가 무산됐다.)

item.title: President Lee on Starbucks’ “5·18 Tank Day”: “Outrage, The Rock Bottom of a Lowly Huckster” (이 대통령 ‘스벅 5·18 탱크데이’에…“분노, 저질 장사치의 막장”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th, regarding Starbucks’ “Tank Day Marketing” held on the anniversary of the May 18th Democratization Movement, stated: “I am outraged by the inhumane, rock-bottom behavior of such a lowly huckster who denies the Korean community, fundamental human rights, and democratic values.” (이재명 대통령이 18일 스타벅스가 5·18 민주화운동 기념일에 진행한 ‘탱크데이 마케팅’을 두고 “대한민국 공동체와 기본적 인권, 민주의 가치를 부정하는 이런 저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장행태에 분노한다”고 했다.)

President Lee wrote on X (formerly Twitter) the same day: “On the historic anniversary of the Gwangju May 18th Democratization Movement, a “5·18 Tank Day” event that mocks the blood-soaked struggle of Gwangju’s victims and citizens? How many lives were unjustly lost that day, and how severely was justice and history damaged? With what grudge did they commit such an act?” (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “역사적인 광주 5·18 민주화운동 기념일에 광주 희생자들과 광주 시민들의 피어린 투쟁을 모독하는 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 이벤트라니”라며 “그날 억울하게 죽어간 생명이 대체 몇이고 그로 인해 정의와 역사의 훼손이 얼마나 엄혹한데 무슨 억하심정으로 이런 짓을 저질렀냐”고 썼다.)

President Lee then added, “They should be given corresponding moral, administrative, legal, and political responsibility. Have they apologized to the May 18th bereaved families and victims?” (이 대통령은 그러면서 “마땅히 그에 상응하는 도덕적, 행정적, 법적, 정치적 책임이 주어져야 할 것”이라며 “5·18 유가족 피해자들에게 사과는 했습니까”라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, Starbucks Korea started selling the “Tank Series” tumbler on that day, using phrases like “Tank Day” and “Tack on the desk” on its website. This led to criticism on online communities and social media (SNS), suggesting that the expression ridiculed or demeaned the May 18th Democratization Movement and the 1987 torture death case of martyr Park Jong-chul. As controversy grew, Starbucks Korea, through an apology issued under the name of CEO Son Jung-hyun, said: “Due to marketing that included inappropriate expressions about the May 18th Democratization Movement, we deeply bow our heads and offer our sincere apologies to the May 18th spirits, the May groups, the citizens of Gwangju, the bereaved family of martyr Park Jong-chul, and all those who led the democratization of Korea, whom we have deeply wounded.” (앞서 스타벅스코리아는 이날 ‘탱크 시리즈’ 텀블러 판매를 시작하며 누리집에 ‘탱크데이’, ‘책상에 탁’이라는 문구 등을 사용했다. 이를 두고 온라인 커뮤니티와 사회관계망서비스(SNS)를 중심으로 해당 표현이 5·18 민주화운동과 1987년 박종철 열사 고문치사 사건을 희화화하거나 비하한 것 아니냐는 지적이 나왔다. 논란이 커지자 스타벅스코리아는 손정현 대표 명의의 사과문을 통해 “5·18 민주화운동에 대한 잘못된 표현이 담긴 마케팅으로 인해 깊은 상처를 입으신 5·18 영령과 오월 단체, 광주 시민분들, 그리고 박종철 열사 유가족분들을 비롯해 대한민국 민주화에 앞장섰던 모든 분께 머리 숙여 깊은 사죄의 말씀을 드린다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Hints at Emergency Mediation for Samsung Electronics; Court Partially Grants Injunction Banning Dispute (대통령도 삼성전자 긴급조정 시사…법원, 쟁의 금지 일부 인용)
item.description:
On the first day of the Central Labor Relations Commission’s (CLRC) second post-mediation meeting for Samsung Electronics’ union on the 18th, President Lee Jae-myung urged an agreement, stating, “In the Republic of Korea, which has adopted a liberal democratic basic order and a capitalist market economy, labor must be respected as much as businesses, and management rights must be respected as much as labor rights.” The President also suggested that he could invoke the emergency mediation right if the union goes on strike. (이재명 대통령이 삼성전자 노조의 중앙노동위원회(중노위) 2차 사후조정 회의 첫날인 18일 “자유민주적 기본질서와 자본주의적 시장경제질서를 채택한 대한민국에서는 기업만큼 노동도 존중되어야 하고, 노동권만큼 기업경영권도 존중돼야 한다”고 합의를 촉구했다. 이 대통령은 노조가 파업에 들어갈 경우 긴급조정권을 발동할 수도 있다는 점도 시사했다.)

President Lee posted on X (formerly Twitter) that day, saying, “Workers must receive fair compensation for their labor, and shareholders who bear risks and losses while investing should have their share of corporate profits,” adding, “At one point, the first Constitution included provisions for workers’ rights to share in corporate profits.” This marks the first time President Lee has commented on the Samsung Electronics strike issue. The Samsung Electronics union has announced a strike starting on the 21st, demanding that 15% of operating profit be institutionalized as performance bonuses without individual caps (50% of annual salary). (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “노동자는 노무 제공에 대해 정당한 노동의 대가를 받을 수 있어야 하고, 위험과 손실을 부담하며 투자한 주주들은 기업 이윤의 몫을 가진다”며 “한때 제헌 헌법에 노동자의 기업 이익 균점권이 규정된 적도 있었다”고 말했다. 이 대통령이 삼성전자 파업 문제에 관해 언급한 것은 처음이다. 삼성전자 노조는 영업이익 15%를 개인별 상한(연봉의 50%) 없이 성과급으로 지급하는 것을 제도화하라며 오는 21일부터 파업을 예고한 상태다.)

President Lee also hinted that if negotiations break down and the union strikes, the government could use its emergency mediation right. Once the emergency mediation right is invoked, the union must suspend the strike for 30 days. President Lee remarked, “Under the current Constitution, the fundamental rights of all citizens are guaranteed, but they can be limited for public welfare as long as the essential content is not infringed upon. Just as there is shade wherever there is sunlight, and deep valleys where there are high mountains, there is a saying: ‘Too much is as bad as too little, and extremes lead to reversals.’” Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said in a national address the previous day, “To protect the national economy, we cannot but consider all possible response measures, including emergency mediation.” (이 대통령은 협상이 결렬돼 노조가 파업에 들어가면 정부가 긴급조정권을 사용할 수 있다는 점도 내비쳤다. 긴급조정권이 발동되면 노조는 30일 동안 파업을 중지해야 한다. 이 대통령은 “현행 헌법상 모든 국민의 기본권은 보장되지만, 본질적 내용을 침해하지 않는 범위 내에서 공공복리 등을 위해 제한될 수 있다”며 “양지만큼 음지가 있고 산이 높으면 골짜기도 깊은 법이다. 과유불급 물극필반(지나침은 모자람만 못하고, 사물이 극단에 이르면 반드시 반전이 있다는 고사성어)”이라고 말했다. 김민석 국무총리는 전날 대국민 담화에서 “국민경제 보호를 위해 긴급조정을 포함한 가능한 모든 대응 수단을 강구하지 않을 수 없다”고 말했다.)

The Samsung Electronics union and management decided to extend the CLRC’s second mediation meeting, which began that day, through the 19th. The CLRC, which mediates labor-management negotiations, stated, “The post-mediation meeting for Samsung Electronics’ labor and management proceeded from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. on the 18th, and the meeting will continue on the 19th.” (삼성전자 노사는 이날 시작한 중노위 2차 조정회의를 19일까지 연장하기로 했다. 노사 협상을 중재하는 중노위는 “삼성전자 노사 사후조정 회의가 18일 오전 10시부터 오후 7시까지 진행됐고, 19일에도 다시 회의가 이어진다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the Suwon District Court partially granted Samsung Electronics’ request for a temporary injunction to ban illegal labor disputes filed against the union that day. (이런 가운데 수원지법은 이날 삼성전자가 노조를 상대로 제기한 위법 쟁의행위 금지 가처분 신청을 일부 인용했다.)

In its ruling, the court stated, “During the period of the dispute, the debtors (the union) must not stop, abolish, or interfere with the maintenance and operation of safety and protection facilities at the same level of staffing, operating hours, operating scale, and duty of care as normal (weekdays or weekends/holidays), nor instruct their union members to do so.” In response, the Samsung Electronics branch of the national industrial union claimed that this allows the facilities to operate with weekend/holiday-level staffing, enabling a strike involving 40,000 participants without hindrance. (재판부는 결정문에서 “채무자들은 쟁의행위 기간 중 안전보호시설이 평상시(평일 또는 주말·휴일)와 동일한 정도의 인력, 가동 시간, 가동 규모, 주의 의무로써 유지·운영되는 것을 정지·폐지 또는 방해하거나 소속 조합원들에게 그와 같은 행위를 하게 해선 안 된다”고 결정했다. 이에 초기업노조 삼성전자지부는 ‘주말·연휴 기준’ 인력으로 (시설) 운영이 가능해 4만여명이 참여하는 파업을 하는 데 지장이 없다고 주장했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
